try.title: Try it yourself
try.lede: Put the demo lamp out with one command on Base Sepolia, then watch it come back on its own.
try.pending: The command appears here once Beacon is deployed.
try.s1: Your poke makes Beacon emit a beat. Flicker reacts to every beat and pays for each reaction.
try.s2: After a few beats Flicker cannot pay. The system contract marks it dark and logs that.
try.s3: Pelita's Keeper hears the log, pays the debt and adds a refill in the same transaction.
try.s4: Flicker is lit again. Its card in the fleet links every hash of the loop.

cost.title: Cost and limits
faq.title: Questions
faq.lede: Answers taken from the README and the measured results.
faq.q1: What does Pelita do while nothing is dark?
faq.a1: Nothing. The Keeper only reacts when a protected contract is marked dark, so while nothing goes dark, nothing is billed.
faq.a2: The protected contract's debt plus the refill its owner chose, paid from the tank, plus the Keeper's own reaction fee. On Base Sepolia the Tank also pays the callback. The measured medians are in Cost and limits above.
faq.q3: Why does Base Sepolia take one more step?
faq.a3: On Lasna the Keeper pays the debt and the refill directly. A contract on Base Sepolia is refuelled through a callback: the Keeper calls the Tank there, and the Tank pays.
faq.q4: Who can relight a dark contract?
faq.a4: Anyone. depositTo needs no permission, so the dark list is open to everyone. Pelita does it on its own only for the contracts its owner protected.
faq.q5: How do I check this without trusting this page?
faq.a5: Clone the repository and run scripts/verify.sh. It needs only Foundry's cast and no key, prints every command before it runs, and reads the deployed addresses, limits and fuel from the chains.
faq.q6: What happens when the tank runs empty?
faq.a6: The Keeper gives up with a reason code and the contract stays dark until someone refuels it. A refuel above maxOwed, or past dailyCap in one day, is refused on purpose.
faq.q7: Can I run my own Pelita?
faq.a7: Yes. With Foundry, a keystore and test coins on Base Sepolia and Lasna, scripts/deploy-your-own.sh deploys a Keeper on Lasna and a Tank on Base Sepolia. Fund them with a plain transfer, then protect a contract you own.
